references.label: Left ramp
references.description: Ramp that lights a random weapon shot and can complete several listed combos.
references.context: Shoot the left ramp to light a random weapon shot.

references.label: Center ramp
references.description: Shot used by several combos and the Honor task.
references.context: Center-ramp shots can advance combos and Honor.

references.label: Purple side targets
references.description: Three targets that light the Viking ship locks.
references.context: Hit all three purple side targets to light ship locks.

references.label: Viking ship
references.description: Lock area used to start War at Sea and the direct-plunge God of Thunder skill shot.
references.context: Three ship locks start War at Sea.

references.label: Berzerker target
references.description: Drop target used to light Mystery and advance Conquest.

references.label: Scoop
references.description: Battle selection, Mystery, Extra Ball, and Valhalla start shot when lit.
references.context: Shoot the scoop for the feature currently lit there.

references.label: Shooter lane
references.description: Alternate battle, Mystery, and Valhalla start shot when lit.
references.context: The shooter lane can start the lit feature.

references.label: Right orbit
references.description: Orbit used with a held left flipper to feed the Viking ship.
references.context: Hold the left flipper while shooting the right orbit to feed the ship.
